blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several roads will be closed in the city of Manila starting Saturday evening, Nov. 28, ahead of a road running event.According to the Manila Public Information Office, the following roads will be closed from 9 p.m. onwards on Saturday due to the AIA Rock and Roll Series Manila on Sunday, Nov. 29: Southbound lane of Roxas Boulevard from Katigbak Drive to P. Ocampo Street and northbound lane of Roxas Boulevard from Quirino Avenue to Katigbak Drive Westbound lane of T.M. Kalaw Avenue from M.H.
